data.name: The Fermentation Project Tasting Kit
data.short_description:
We are so excited to participate in the Fermentation Project as a roaster! In our tasting kit you will receive four 60g samples. The samples are all created from the same coffee from Antigua, Guatemala, and each is fermented a different way. The fermentation processes featured are:

-Mechanically Demucilaged

-Wild Fermentation

-Lactobacillus Inoculated

-Yeast Inoculated


The Live Tasting event will take place October 3rd, 9am CST. This is a presale link, so coffees will be roasted September 22nd to ship out September 24th.
